signals.entity: Hungarian ATM mandate — Act XVIII of 2025 (ATMtv.), NGM decree 16/2025 (V. 29.), MNB decree 19/2025 (VI. 26.)
signals.signal: [STANDING — dated 2025, RE-VERIFIED 27/08/2026 AGAINST THE PRIMARY DECREE TEXTS; CORRECTS THE 01/08 FILE]. Both decrees remain in force UNAMENDED (consolidated text stamps: NGM 16/2025 'Hatály: 2025.VI.6. -'; MNB 19/2025 'Hatály: 2025.VI.27. -'; no 2026 amendment). NGM 16/2025 §1 sets the two phases on 2022 census data: (a) from 31/12/2025 in every settlement above 1,000 inhabitants, (b) from 31/12/2026 in every settlement above 500 inhabitants. MNB 19/2025 Annex 1 ('A pénzforgalmi szolgáltatók telepítéssel érintett településenkénti meghatározása') lists 1,039 named settlements grouped into 80 SETTLEMENT PACKAGES (településcsomag), each package assigned to ONE obligated payment service provider. Verified package split counted directly from Annex 1: OTP Bank Nyrt. 33, MBH Bank Nyrt. 15, K&H Bank Zrt. 9, ERSTE BANK HUNGARY Zrt. 8, Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. 5, CIB Bank Zrt. 4, UniCredit Bank Hungary Zrt. 4, GRÁNIT Bank Nyrt. 1, MagNet Bank Zrt. 1 — nine institutions, 80 packages. THE DECREE DOES NOT PUBLISH A PER-BANK ATM COUNT, only settlements per package; the per-bank ATM numbers struck from the 01/08 file are still NOT restated because no such column exists in Annex 1. §3(2)-(3) let banks swap packages or individual settlements and take over each other's obligations by contract (minimum 5-year term for an operating hand-over), with contract deadlines 20/07/2025 for phase (a) and 28/02/2026 for phase (b), notified to MNB via the ERA system by 31/07/2025 and 16/03/2026 respectively; §4 requires a review at least every three years and a new operator to reimburse the previous operator's documented installation costs within 3 years. Municipalities must supply a free, accessible, lit, powered and internet-connected site (NGM 16/2025 §2). OTP Bank and other credit institutions filed a Constitutional Court (Alkotmánybíróság) challenge on 10/11/2025 arguing the mandate is economically unjustified and disproportionately restricts their property and business rights; no decision found as of 27/08/2026 — status unverified this run.
signals.source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár / net.jogtar.hu consolidated texts of MNB decree 19/2025 (VI. 26.) and NGM decree 16/2025 (V. 29.), PDFs extracted locally
signals.implies: ~1,039 rural sites must have a working cash dispenser by 31/12/2026, allocated by decree to nine banks — a footprint-wide ATM, ATM-monitoring, cash-optimisation, physical-security and field-service opportunity that will NEVER appear as a tender. Printec's route is bank-by-bank (NCR Atleos hardware, x-core multivendor software, telemetry, APTRA OptiCash for the low-volume rural cash cycle, and managed field service for scattered sites), with OTP, MBH and K&H carrying 57 of the 80 packages. The phase-(b) swap deadline of 28/02/2026 has already passed, so the final bank-by-settlement map is now fixed for 2026.
signals.likelihood: Hard statutory deadline 31/12/2026; installs must happen in H2 2026
signals.followup: Obtain the post-28/02/2026 swap/hand-over picture from MNB's ERA notifications; approach OTP, MBH and K&H procurement directly on rural low-footfall ATM hardware, monitoring and field service; track the Alkotmánybíróság case for any suspension.

signals.entity: EKR (ekr.gov.hu) coverage of the Hungarian ATM mandate and of Hungarian commercial banks
signals.signal: STRUCTURAL FINDING, verified this run: the Act XVIII of 2025 ATM rollout generates ZERO procurement notices on EKR. Full-corpus CSV exports of the EKR public-notice register for 'Bankjegy' (9 notices, all Magyar Nemzeti Bank, none later than 24/09/2025), 'bankjegykiadó' (0), 'Pénzkiadó'/'pénzkiadó' (0), 'ATM' (11, none cash-related — in Hungarian public procurement 'ATM' means Air Traffic Management), 'Önkiszolgáló'/'önkiszolgáló' (4, none banking) returned no ATM-supply procedure whatsoever in 2026. The reason is structural, not a search failure: the obligated entities under Annex 1 of MNB decree 19/2025 are nine PRIVATE commercial banks (OTP, MBH, K&H, Erste, Raiffeisen, CIB, UniCredit, Gránit, MagNet), which are not contracting authorities under the Hungarian Public Procurement Act (Kbt.) for this spend, and the obligation is allocated by decree rather than competed. This closes the 'Hungarian Act XVIII public-procurement coverage verdict' item left UNCONFIRMED at 01/08/2026. Correspondingly, Magyar Posta Zrt. — the other plausible national cash-access channel — published 20 EKR notices between 02/2026 and 27/08/2026 and NOT ONE touches ATMs, POS, cash automation or self-service (they are printer consumables, contact-centre, workwear, cleaning, gardening, e-bikes, PDA accessories and passenger transport).
signals.source_name: EKR public notice register, CSV export endpoint /api/publikus/kozbeszerzesi-hirdetmenyek/exportalas/csv (keyword and buyer-name sweeps run 27/08/2026)
signals.implies: Do not staff a Hungarian ATM tender-watch. The ~1,039-site rollout must be won through direct bank-by-bank commercial engagement and through the incumbent ATM vendors' channels, not through EKR/TED. EKR remains valuable for Hungary only for MNB, state agencies, transit and state-owned enterprises — which is where all 12 signals in this file come from.
signals.likelihood: Structural; unchanged for the life of the mandate
signals.followup: Re-run the same keyword sweep quarterly in case a state vehicle (e.g. Magyar Posta or a state fund) is later used to procure rural ATMs.

coverage_notes: Portal: Hungary EKR (ekr.gov.hu). Route used: the SPA at /portal returns index.html for every path, but the public API and assets live at the ROOT host. Working endpoints found by reading the Angular bundle at https://ekr.gov.hu/main.<hash>.bundle.js: (1) JSON search /api/publikus/kozbeszerzesi-hirdetmenyek?eljarasTargya=&ajanlatkeroNeve= — capped at 10 rows and the `page` parameter is SILENTLY IGNORED (every page returns the same 10), so it is only usable for narrow queries; (2) full-corpus CSV export /api/publikus/kozbeszerzesi-hirdetmenyek/exportalas/csv with the same filters — the only route to complete result sets; (3) notice detail /api/publikus/kozbeszerzesi-hirdetmenyek/{id} which exposes eljarasNyertesAjanlattevoNeve (THE WINNER), procedure technical id, procedure type and gazette issue; (4) full notice PDF /api/publikus/kozbeszerzesi-hirdetmenyek/{id}/dokumentum-letoltes, extracted locally with pdfminer for values, quantities, tax numbers and deadlines. Search is CASE-SENSITIVE substring on the subject line, so every keyword was run in both capitalisations. Keyword sweep run in Hungarian and English: Bankjegy/bankjegy, bankjegykiadó, Pénzkiadó/pénzkiadó, ATM/atm, Önkiszolgáló/önkiszolgáló, Kioszk/kioszk/KIOSZK, Készpénz/készpénz, Pénzfeldolgoz/pénzfeldolgoz, POS, Terminál/terminál, Bankkártya/bankkártya, Kártyaelfogad/kártyaelfogad, Számláló/számláló, Érme/érmé, Csomagoló/csomagoló, Széf/széf, pénztárgép, Bank/bank/banki, Biometri/biometri, Pénzszállít/pénzszállít, elektronikus aláírás, ügyfélazonosít, AML, pénzmosás, csalás, Tranzakció/tranzakció, DORA, kártyaszemélyesít/kártyagyárt/kártyakibocsát, dokumentumkezel, iratkezel, sorszámoszt, videóbank, azonnali fizetés, ISO 20022, qvik/Qvik/QVIK, banktechn. Buyer-name sweeps: Magyar Nemzeti Bank (1,037 notices, all years, CSV), Magyar Posta (20 notices since 02/2026). PRODUCT-CATEGORY VERDICT for this portal this run — NOTHING FOUND on EKR in 2026 for: (1) ATM & cash automation/recycling as new-build supply (only maintenance: Mile Banktechnika, and the Act XVIII rollout which is off-portal by design); (5) digital identity/onboarding/e-signature as a banking procurement (only the ORFK EES biometric border kit); (6) fraud & transaction monitoring as a standalone buy (only embedded in the BKK cEMV and MNB cyber-risk-monitoring scopes); (7) compliance & operational resilience — ZERO hits for DORA, AML, pénzmosás; (8) physical ATM security — ZERO; (10) card issuing & personalisation — ZERO hits for kártyaszemélyesítés, kártyagyártás, kártyakibocsátás; (12) core & digital channels — ZERO banking-core notices. Categories that DID produce signals: (2) self-service kiosks (ORFK, 16+4 kiosks + 8 ABC gates); (3) POS/acquiring/TMS/softPOS (MÁK, BKK, NAV, Diákhitel, FestiPay); (4) payments modernisation incl. instant payments (qvik across MÁK/NAV/BKK, and BKK cEMV open-loop); (9) HSM/key management (MNB x2); (11) managed services/field maintenance (Mile Banktechnika, MÁV CIT, MNB/G+D). Baseline carry-overs statused: MNB 'Hálózati kulcstároló eszközök' — CLOSED 24/08/2026, award pending, scope now known (3x Entrust nShield 5c Mid); Hungarian National Police EES kiosks/biometrics — CLOSED 28/07/2026 after five re-publications, award pending; Hungarian Act XVIII public-procurement coverage verdict — RESOLVED (out of scope of Kbt., zero EKR notices); MNB decree 19/2025 per-bank allocation — RE-VERIFIED from the decree itself (80 packages / 1,039 settlements / 9 banks) and the struck per-bank ATM counts deliberately NOT restated. Genuine gaps: (a) no estimated value is published by MNB, NAV, ORFK or BKK on their open notices — a disclosure gap, not an absence of budget; (b) no primary source found stating how many of the ~1,039 mandated ATMs are already installed as at 08/2026, and MNB publishes no running counter; (c) the Alkotmánybíróság ruling on the OTP-led challenge to Act XVIII could not be located — status unverified this run; (d) Hungarian commercial banks are private and publish no tenders, so their ATM/POS/recycler buying is invisible on EKR by design.
access_issues: ekr.gov.hu/portal/* returns the Angular index.html for EVERY path including the JS bundles (SPA catch-all) — the fix was to fetch assets and API from the ROOT host (https://ekr.gov.hu/main.<hash>.bundle.js, https://ekr.gov.hu/api/...). https://ekr.gov.hu/ekr-em/... 302-redirects back to /portal. All requests sent with a desktop Chrome User-Agent; no 403s or CAPTCHAs encountered and no login wall hit — the entire notice corpus and every notice PDF are public. The JSON search endpoint silently ignores `page` (confirmed: 104 sequential page requests for Magyar Nemzeti Bank returned 1,040 rows containing only 10 distinct ids) — worked around with the CSV export endpoint. net.jogtar.hu/getpdf for MNB decree 19/2025 truncated on the first attempt (pdfminer 'Unexpected EOF' at 1,679,160 bytes); re-fetched with -L --retry 2 and a 300s timeout to a complete 1,877,802-byte file and extracted locally. https://njt.hu/jogszabaly/2025-19-20-2C returned 'socket hang up' to the fetch tool; substituted the net.jogtar.hu consolidated PDF (same consolidated text, primary). The EKR opendata result-report URL (/api/publikus/eredmeny-tajekoztato-hirdetmenyek-url/hu?id=...) resolves to a 7 MB SeekTable JavaScript report that yields no extractable text — the notice PDF route was used instead for every award.
operator_requests: none — every EKR notice, notice PDF and Hungarian decree needed for this run was retrieved without a paywall, login or CAPTCHA.
